notes: Single program plus two artifacts: derive a hidden width H from a min/max combined-parameter budget (P = F*H + H + C*H + C), build torch nn.Linear instance_encoder and bag_classifier with consistent shapes, save the state dict, and emit a truthful report the verifier recomputes. One hidden config admits exactly one feasible H, so hard-coded or arbitrary widths fail the initialization adequacy checks (presence, non-None, shape consistency, finite values, budget). Rubric: tool_breadth (torch), reasoning_depth (closed-form budget solve), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden configs incl. single-solution), quantitative_correctness (exact parameter counts).
